mapper.select: select s.tenant_id, s.app_id, s.user_id, s.id as session_id from user_session s join user_account u on u.id = s.user_id and u.tenant_id = s.tenant_id and u.app_id = s.app_id where s.session_token_hash = #{sessionTokenHash} and s.revoked = false and s.expired_at > now() and u.deleted = false and u.status = 'ACTIVE' limit 1
select id, tenant_id, app_id, email, display_name, status, register_source from user_account where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and app_id = #{appId} and email = #{email} and deleted = false limit 1
mapper.update: update user_account set email = null, mobile = null, display_name = 'ERASED_USER', status = 'DELETED', deleted = true, updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and app_id = #{appId} and id = #{userId} and deleted = false
